title: Constant fibre dimension near a zero-dimensional fibre stalk
statement: Let $f:X\to T$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme] and $U\subseteq T$ an open such that $f|_U$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally finitely presented [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Let $x\in X$ with $f(x)\in U$, and assume that the local ring of the scheme-theoretic fibre $X_{f(x)}$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre] at $x$ has Krull dimension zero [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring; def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. Then there exist $n\in\mathbb N$ and an open neighbourhood $V\subseteq X$ of $x$, lying over $U$, such that for every $y\in V$ the local topological dimension of $X_{f(y)}$ at $y$ [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point] is $n$. The integer $n$ need not be zero.

source.place: Tags 045U, 02NM and 02NJ; dimension-zero-stalk special case of the local neighbourhood construction in Tag 054T

proof.text: The restricted-fibre theorem makes f.fiber (f x) locally Noetherian, hence its stalk at f.asFiber x is a nontrivial Noetherian local ring. Apply IsLocalRing.depth_le_supportDim to this ring as a module over itself, and Mathlib Module.supportDim_self_eq_ringKrullDim. Depth is nonnegative and the given ring dimension is zero, so antisymmetry gives depth equal to ring dimension.

Use openness of the restricted fibre Cohen-Macaulay locus to form the open W of all y with f(y) in U and fibre-stalk depth equal to fibre-stalk ring dimension. The preceding equality shows x lies in W. Apply the dimension-partition theorem to W, obtaining a family V n of opens with supremum W and local fibre dimension n on V n.

Rewrite membership of x in W using the supremum equality and Opens.mem_iSup to choose n with x in V n. For y in V n, Opens.mem_iSup and the same equality give y in W, whose first conjunct is f(y) in U. The partition theorem gives the required local topological dimension equality. Take the witnesses n and V n.

proof_origin.place: Tags 045U, 02NM, 02NJ, 0A21 (3), (5); depth-zero criterion via the already proved depth-support bound (00LK).

lean.statement:
theorem exists_constant_fibre_dimension_neighbourhood_of_stalk_dimension_zero
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) (U : T.Opens)
    [Flat (f ∣_ U)] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation (f ∣_ U)]
    (x : X) (hx : f x ∈ U)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim ((f.fiber (f x)).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber x)) = 0) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (V : X.Opens), x ∈ V ∧
      ∀ y ∈ V, f y ∈ U ∧ topologicalKrullDimAt (f.asFiber y) = (n : WithBot ℕ∞)
